rationale: These five retained excerpts contain task instructions but no independently identifiable audience. Both PERSONAL-only and WORKER-only labels relied on omitted surrounding context. Numbering and second-person grammar do not independently establish an owner or worker recipient.
invariants: Original corpus, scorer and first result remain unchanged
Audience classification is excluded, never credited as correct
At most one task proposal; no other authoritative proposal kind
Original instruction remains in the action-bearing original_instruction, or absent that in a PERSONAL_TASK title; arbitrary notes do not excuse a different action
No invented worker, site, date, assignment, translation or owner approval
All-UNRESOLVED output is a coverage gap, never successful task extraction
All determinate cases retain the original exact route, field and safety checks
